name: EL ENCANTO SD
notes: 3 photos: 1 was a seasonal drinks/specials board (lattes, matcha), 2 and 3 were duplicate shots of the same breakfast food menu page; duplicates merged.

dishes.name: Oatmeal
dishes.description: Warm oatmeal served with seasonal fruit and toasted bread.

dishes.name: Fruit Salad
dishes.description: Fresh seasonal fruit, creamy cottage cheese & golden granola.

dishes.name: Breakfast Croissant
dishes.description: Buttery croissant layered with chipotle sauce, avocado, bacon, ham, tomato, lettuce & egg. Served on a bed of spring mix.

dishes.name: Two Avocado Toast
dishes.description: Whole-grain toast topped with creamy avocado, panela cheese, cherry tomatoes & fresh cilantro. Served on spring mix.

dishes.name: The Morning Beagle
dishes.description: Turkey ham, bacon, egg, American cheese, fresh lettuce, tomato, served on a bed of spring mix & chipotle on the side.

dishes.name: Two Eggs Any Style
dishes.description: Classic breakfast with two eggs your way, house-seasoned potatoes, beans & toast.

dishes.name: Machaca Sonora
dishes.description: Sonora-style shredded dried beef with serrano peppers, tomato & onion. Served with beans, house potatoes, panela cheese & tortillas.

dishes.name: Huevos Divorciados
dishes.description: Two eggs any style over crispy tortillas, topped with panela cheese, pickled onions & cilantro. Served with beans, house potatoes & homemade salsa.

dishes.name: Los Chilaquiles
dishes.description: Crispy tortillas bathed in your favorite sauce (rojos, verdes, chipotle or mole), topped with sour cream, cotija cheese, pickled onions, cilantro & avocado. Served with beans & house potatoes.

dishes.name: Con Chorizo
dishes.description: Served with house potatoes, beans & tortillas.

dishes.name: A la Mexicana
dishes.description: Served with house potatoes, beans & tortillas.

dishes.name: Con Jamón
dishes.description: Served with house potatoes, beans & tortillas.

dishes.name: Egg Whites Omelette
dishes.description: Spinach, mushrooms, mozzarella & avocado. Topped with salsa & sour cream, served with house potatoes, beans & tortillas.

dishes.name: Chorizo Omelette
dishes.description: Longaniza, tomato, onion & mozzarella. Topped with salsa & sour cream, served with house potatoes, beans & tortillas.

dishes.name: Machaca Omelette
dishes.description: Sonoran machaca with serrano peppers & mozzarella, onion, tomato. Topped with salsa & sour cream, served with house potatoes, beans & tortillas.

dishes.name: Ham Omelette
dishes.description: Turkey ham, mushrooms & mozzarella. Topped with salsa & sour cream, served with house potatoes, beans & tortillas.

dishes.name: Pancakes Platter
dishes.description: 12 fluffy pancakes topped with butter & powdered sugar. Served with two eggs any style, bacon, banana & berries.

dishes.name: French Toast Platter
dishes.description: Eight pieces topped with butter & powdered sugar. Served with two eggs any style, bacon, banana & berries.

dishes.name: Waffles Platter
dishes.description: Golden waffles topped with butter & powdered sugar. Served with two eggs any style, bacon, banana & berries.

dishes.name: Rompope Latte
dishes.description: Traditional Mexican eggnog-inspired latte made with espresso, creamy milk, and rich rompope flavor, finished with warm notes of vanilla and cinnamon. Available hot or iced.

dishes.name: Lotus Latte
dishes.description: Espresso blended with creamy milk and the delicious flavor of Lotus Biscoff, smooth, sweet, and comforting. Available hot or iced.

dishes.name: Ibarra Mocha
dishes.description: Espresso paired with authentic Mexican Ibarra chocolate and creamy milk for a rich and indulgent mocha experience. Available hot or iced.

dishes.name: Ceremonial Matcha
dishes.description: Authentic ceremonial-grade matcha sourced from Uji, Japan, known for its rich flavor, vibrant color, and exceptionally smooth finish. Available hot or iced.

dishes.name: Premium Matcha
dishes.description: Smooth, vibrant matcha with a balanced flavor profile. Available hot or iced.

dishes.name: Strawberry Matcha
dishes.description: Premium matcha layered over homemade strawberry jam, made fresh in-house for a sweet and refreshing finish. Served iced.

dishes.name: Matcha with Lotus Foam
dishes.description: Premium iced matcha topped with creamy Lotus Biscoff cold foam, smooth, sweet, and indulgent.

dishes.name: Matcha with Rompope Foam
dishes.description: Premium iced matcha topped with velvety rompope cold foam, inspired by traditional Mexican eggnog with notes of vanilla and cinnamon.
